name: LaTeX Studio
author: Acxel Orozco
description: LaTeX paper workspace with syntax-highlighted editing, latexmk builds, PDF preview and a Git-relay collaboration workflow: commit, pull, push, sync, auto-pull and conflict handling.
dependency_note: PyMuPDF enables inline PDF preview. Google API/OAuth wheels enable the optional Google Drive relay; inject them with WPM into the private latex_studio target. Git relay and Open PDF work without them.
